description: Achieve maximum Runtime autonomy by identifying, prioritizing, implementing, validating and documenting every improvement required for autonomous mission execution.
global_rules: The Runtime is responsible for completing this mission.
Continue working until all achievable objectives are completed.
Do not stop because a pipeline stage has finished.
Stop only if governance blocks execution, the mission is completed or a real blocking issue is demonstrated.
Create follow-up objectives automatically when new problems are discovered.
Prioritize Runtime autonomy over new business features.

execution_policy.external_ai_goal: Use available AI systems only when they can improve analysis, implementation, validation or problem solving.

primary_objectives: Identify every blocker preventing full Runtime autonomy.
definition_of_done: Every identified issue has been analysed.
No remaining fix is achievable without governance or human approval.
completion: Runtime has completed every achievable improvement.
All remaining blockers are documented with evidence.
Runtime is ready for the next autonomous mission.
